# Project Context Map

This directory contains essential context information for AI agents and developers working on the Bonanza Insumos project.

## 📑 Contents

- **[PROJECT-OVERVIEW.md](PROJECT-OVERVIEW.md)** - High-level project description, purpose, and current status
- **[DATABASE-SCHEMA.md](DATABASE-SCHEMA.md)** - Database models, relationships, and migrations


## 🚀 Quick Start

```bash
# Install dependencies
composer install && npm install

# Setup database
php artisan migrate
php artisan seed:fresh

# Start development server
npm run build
php artisan serve

# Or run everything together
composer dev
```

## 👤 Key Contacts & Documentation

- **Framework Documentation**: https://laravel.com/docs
- **Frontend Framework**: Alpine.js 3.15 (https://alpinejs.dev)
- **CSS Framework**: Tailwind CSS 4 (https://tailwindcss.com)
- **Build Tool**: Vite 8 (https://vitejs.dev)
